name: jan-browser
description: Minimal browser extension that connects Jan's MCP tools to the active browser.

scripts.dev:mcp: bash -lc 'cd mcp-server && if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run dev; else npm run dev; fi'
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:all:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:mcp
